resources.string: Configure terminal, keyboard, gestures and advanced properties

Saved to ~/.config/termuxpp/termuxpp.properties. Legacy settings are copied on the first change; the original is kept. Clear a text field or select App default to reset a setting. Changes reload when returning to the terminal; some require a new session or app restart. Text fields accept the same syntax as the properties file.
Cannot read properties. No settings will be overwritten.
Allow external apps to execute commands in TermuxPP. Only enable this if you trust the apps granted the Run commands permission.
This layout cannot be opened visually. Repair it in Advanced JSON or restore the default. Nothing is saved until you tap Save.

Tap a key to edit it. Add keys and rows below, or move them using the arrow buttons. Swipe up on a terminal key to use its optional secondary action. This preview never sends keystrokes. Changes remain a draft until Save.
No extra keys. Add a row to begin.
Remove this row and its keys from the draft?
Replace the draft with the default layout? Tap Save afterwards to remove the custom layout override.
Optional advanced editor. Enter an array of key rows, for example [[\"ESC\",\"TAB\",\"CTRL\"]]. Invalid input stays open for correction.

Choose a common key or type literal text. Enable Macro for a space-separated key sequence, for example CTRL c. An optional label changes only the displayed text. Swipe-up fields define a secondary key; leave them empty for none.
